value.rationale: Environmental molecular-age inference has empirical motivation. The exact two-pool threshold identifies a previously non-obvious, structurally robust failure of interpreting a high RNA:DNA ratio as younger material even when RNA decays faster in each molecular pool, including a minimal two-pool construction and a precisely three-valued age map. The result offers a testable modelling criterion, not a field recommendation.
